subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add orphan `SKILL.md` detection outside configured skill roots, and should it run in `openclaw skills check`, Doctor, status, startup, or docs only?
rationale: The missing diagnostic is clear in source, but scanning outside configured roots has privacy, performance, false-positive, and startup-noise tradeoffs that require maintainer product intent.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and remediation to move, install, or configure the skill.

options.title: Also Warn At Startup/Status
options.body: Surface the warning during startup or status as well, accepting broader runtime scanning and more operator-visible noise.

options.title: Document Current Scope Only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured roots and improve docs instead of adding off-root filesystem scanning.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and remediation to move, install, or configure the skill.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history trail across skills CLI, skill-creator, and workspace skill audit surfaces where this product boundary would be decided.
